newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks end flat as labor strife continues.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks end flat as labor strife continues.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed broadly flat in slow trade as investors continued to shun shares while Venezuelan labor problems continued, traders and analysts said.
"First the doctors striked, then the teachers, and now it's investors," said New York-based Credit Lyonnais broker Peter Ryan.
"There's still a lot of upside in the market, but prices are only going to move again on positive achievements -- delivered growth, lower inflation, a settlement of the strikes," he added.
